newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian electricity use falls 0.5 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Italian electricity use falls 0.5 pct in August.

text.p: Italian electricity usage in August fell a seasonally adjusted 0.5 percent compared to the same month in 1995, according to data from electricity utility ENEL.
On an unadjusted basis, electricity consumption fell 0.9 percent last month, with one working day less in August 1996 than in August last year.
In the first eight months of this year, consumption of electricity rose an unadjusted 0.8 percent compared to the January-August period in 1995, ENEL said.
